nodes.label: "An owning RS_BlockList frees its blocks when destroyed"
"Clearing a block list tells the listeners once, with the list empty and the blocks alive"
"Clearing a non-owning block list tells the listeners and frees nothing"
"A block list tells its listeners once when it is destroyed, before it frees the blocks"
"A non-owning block list tells its listeners when it is destroyed and frees nothing"
"A block list is destroyed without listeners, and after they unregistered"
"A block listener that unregisters itself when its list is destroyed does not make the next one miss it"
"Clearing an owning RS_BlockList frees its blocks and forgets the active one"
"RS_BlockList::add frees a rejected duplicate but never a block it holds"
"A drawing frees its blocks when re-initialised and destroyed"
"A non-owning RS_BlockList leaves removed and rejected blocks to the caller"
"An insert does not reuse a block cached against a destroyed list"
"A font frees its letters unless it does not own them"
"A pasted insert keeps its blocks after the source and the clipboard are gone"
